definitions.code: def completeSourceCounter (q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Nat:=sourceSubtotal completeLocalDebit q T S

def sourceSubtotal (localDebit : OrdinaryWork) (q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Nat :=
 localDebit T S q+
 (((ordinaryStepTrace FastOrdinary.solve q T S).queries.attach).map fun pb=>
  sourceSubtotal localDebit pb.val.2 pb.val.1.1 pb.val.1.2).sum

definitions.name: OrdinaryDispatch.FastOrdinary.solve
definitions.code:
def solve (q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Option CommonForest :=
 if DepthOne.proper T S then
  match DepthOne.pretest01 T S with
  | .refused => none
  | .found c => if DepthOne.cutCost c≤q then some (DepthOne.forest S c) else none
  | .rejected =>
   let paid := fun u v r => if hr : r<q then solve r u v else none
   match early T S with
   | .common reverse c =>
     let p := commonPair T S reverse c
     if hn : (leaves p.1).length<(leaves T).length then
       (solve q p.1 p.2).map (expandCommon T S reverse c)
     else none
   | .one reverse c =>
     let p := Oriented reverse T S
     runChildren paid p.1 p.2 q [pendantChild p.2 c.a c.b]
   | .high reverse c =>
     let p := Oriented reverse T S
     runChildren paid p.1 p.2 q (branches p.2 c.a c.b)
   | .rule4Forward s => runRule4 paid s q
   | .rule4Reverse s => runRule4 paid s q
   | .hard2 c d => Hard2Dispatcher.run paid T S c d q
   | .refused => none
 else none

definitions.name: OrdinaryDispatch.WorkIntegration.hard2Trace
source_context_lines: open RMAF ForestState Universal233 Universal233.BothBad Universal233.PaidQueries
definitions.code:
def hard2Trace (actual : Ordinary) (T S : Tree) (c _d : Candidate) (q : Nat) : Hard2Receipt :=
 match runHard2 T S c with
 | none => ⟨none,[]⟩
 | some .disjoint =>
  let P := pendantPartition S c.a c.b
  if P.all (restrictionAgrees T S) then ⟨DisjointParents.direct P q,[]⟩
  else if (P.filter (restrictionAgrees T S)).length=2 then
   let r := Rule5ActualTrace.dispatchTrace actual T S c.a c.b q
   ⟨Rule5ActualTrace.answer r,Rule5ActualTrace.queries actual r.calls⟩
  else
   let r := Hard2Trace.disjointExecution actual T S c.a c.b q
   ⟨r.answer,forestQueries actual r.calls⟩
 | some out =>
  let r := Hard2Combine.combine actual T S c.a c.b q (paidCase actual T S c q out)
  ⟨r.answer,forestQueries actual r.calls⟩

definitions.name: OrdinaryDispatch.WorkRecursion.ordinaryStepTrace
definitions.code:
def ordinaryStepTrace (rec : Nat→Tree→Tree→Option CommonForest) (q : Nat) (T S : Tree) : Hard2Receipt :=
 if DepthOne.proper T S then
  match DepthOne.pretest01 T S with
  | .refused => ⟨none,[]⟩
  | .found c => ⟨if DepthOne.cutCost c≤q then some (DepthOne.forest S c) else none,[]⟩
  | .rejected =>
   let paid := cutoff rec q
   match early T S with
   | .common reverse c =>
     let p := commonPair T S reverse c
     if (leaves p.1).length<(leaves T).length then
      ⟨(rec q p.1 p.2).map (expandCommon T S reverse c),[(p,q)]⟩
     else ⟨none,[]⟩
   | .one reverse c =>
     let p := Oriented reverse T S
     childrenTrace paid p.1 p.2 q [pendantChild p.2 c.a c.b]
   | .high reverse c =>
     let p := Oriented reverse T S
     childrenTrace paid p.1 p.2 q (branches p.2 c.a c.b)
   | .rule4Forward s => rule4Trace paid s q
   | .rule4Reverse s => rule4Trace paid s q
   | .hard2 c d => hard2Trace paid T S c d q
   | .refused => ⟨none,[]⟩
 else ⟨none,[]⟩

query_exact_definition.name: OrdinaryDispatch.QueryExact
source_context_lines: open RMAF ForestState Universal233 Universal233.CherryBranching Universal233.HardParent
query_exact_definition.code:
def QueryExact (T S : Tree) (q : Nat) : Option CommonForest → Prop
 | none => ∀ F, agreement T S F=true → q<F.length-1
 | some F => agreement T S F=true ∧ F.length-1≤q ∧
     ∀G,agreement T S G=true → F.length≤G.length

source_optimizer_bound_type.name: ExplicitSourceOptimizer20261022.optimum_k_source_bound
source_optimizer_bound_type.type:
theorem optimum_k_source_bound (T S : Tree) (L : Nat)
    (proper : DepthOne.proper T S=true)
    (labels : ∀x,x∈leaves T++leaves S → x<2^L) :
    ∃ k o,
      (optimize T S).output=some o ∧
      o.partition.length=k ∧ 0<k ∧
      agreement T S o.partition=true ∧
      (∀G,agreement T S G=true → k≤G.length) ∧
      (sourceOptimizeMeter (fun b=>completeSourceCounter b T S) T S).value=optimize T S ∧
      ((sourceOptimizeMeter (fun b=>completeSourceCounter b T S) T S).work : Rat)≤
        (sourceOptimizerPolynomial (leaves T).length L : Rat)*(233/100:Rat)^(k-1)

explicit_P_definition:
def sourceOptimizerPolynomial (n L : Nat) : Nat :=
  n*((outerJoinedPolynomial n n L+
    (disjointRunPolynomial (2*n+3)+badPairLocalPolynomialExpression (2*n+3) n+
      32*(2^50*(2*n+3+n+2)^8)))*1024*(n+1))+
  512*(2*n+1)^2+64*(recoveryEnvelope n+32)
